brief:
A British activist forcibly abducted by Israeli settlers in the occupied West Bank has been deported to the UK, The Guardian reported. Finn Joughin, 22, was taken by settlers before Israeli authorities subsequently moved to expel him from the country. His case emerges during a documented surge in settler violence targeting Palestinians across the territory.

The abduction and deportation underscore mounting tensions between international activists and Israeli settlement communities in the West Bank. Joughin's removal occurs amid broader patterns of settler aggression that have intensified across the occupied territory in recent months, with Palestinian communities bearing the brunt of confrontations.
